description: Only invoices that have line items are averaged over.

b.request: Return one row with the average, across only invoices that have at least one line item and at least one non-missing `product_price`, of each invoice's mean non-missing `product_price` in `Invoice_Line_Items`, and the average, across only invoices that have at least one line item, of the number of line items per invoice, both unrounded.
b.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) SELECT (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM per_invoice WHERE avg_price IS NOT NULL) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT AVG(item_count * 1.0) FROM per_invoice) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice
b.raw: Return one row with the average, across only invoices that have at least one line item and at least one non-missing `product_price`, of each invoice's mean non-missing `product_price` in `Invoice_Line_Items`, and the average, across only invoices that have at least one line item, of the number of line items per invoice, both unrounded.

c.request: Per invoice, what is the average of the invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items on an invoice? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded. Only invoices that have line items are averaged over.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(cnt) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) AS t

d.request: Compute, for each invoice that has at least one line item in Invoice_Line_Items, the mean of its non-null product_price values (skipping invoices with no non-null price) and its count of line items. Return a single row with the unrounded average of those per-invoice mean prices and the unrounded average of the per-invoice line-item counts, both over invoices that have line items.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_mean_prices, AVG(cnt) AS avg_line_item_count FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING AVG(product_price) IS NOT NULL)

a.request: Across the invoices that have at least one line item, what is the average of each invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items per invoice? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) AS t
